sourceEligibility.nativeMaterialTargetPolicy: Only the two individually closed original STL shell copies are material targets; the touching assembled native mesh is retained for appearance and directed hole rays.

method.classification: Three oblique orientation-independent geometric crossing parities must all be odd. Near-zero actual hits classify boundary; bounding boxes only reject points outside. Signed balances are diagnostic because procedural hole wall winding can differ from cap winding.

samplingPolicy.scope: Normal offsets and finite grids may miss overlaps narrower than their coverage. Actual boundary classifications use the probe epsilon; shared-surface counts are diagnostic, not a manufacturing contact-area estimate. Procedural source normals can differ around true bores; inward samples require independent actual-mesh material confirmation.

method.uncertainPolicy: Non-boundary disagreement is a distinct uncertain result, never an outside/clear result. Uncertain source points are excluded from strict interior samples and remain counted; uncertain target and grid queries remain explicit.

internalJoins.policy: Counts are retained. Molded-plastic unions, embedded conductors, folded metal and solder-pad connections are appearance assembly joins. Nominal-radius polygon seam interference and air separation are separately measured rather than erased or reclassified as zero.

nominalRadiusSeams.scope: Finite actual radial triangle intersections at stated sections. These are observed extrema over 720 offset angles, not global Euclidean penetration depths or manufacturing tolerances.

groveSolderContact.change: The former radius0.23 circular bore left a minimum observed gap0.003725845mm around the0.32 square leg. The final solder geometry uses an actual0.32 square bore; all384 tested section/angle contacts close without radial interpenetration.

classifierCorrection.bug: Signed normal balances mislabeled points in real PCB drill holes as material when procedural sidewall winding differed from cap winding. Two geometric crossings gave signed balance2. The initial wide-hole-centre fixtures did not expose this.
classifierCorrection.correction: Final classification uses orientation-independent crossing parity on closed-eligible meshes, adds near-bore-wall and globally reversed-winding fixtures, and explicitly records non-boundary disagreement as uncertain. Actual multi-hole PCB controls also pass.

limitations: Finite mesh samples and volume grids do not establish exhaustive intersection exclusion, exact CSG union, complete watertightness or manufacturing fit.
Original native assembly retains touching non-manifold edges and numerical merge seams; only independent original closed shell copies serve as interior targets.
Positive material classification requires agreement in three directions. Non-boundary directional disagreement is uncertain and is not evidence of empty material.

Triangle normal offsets, finite angular sections and finite volume grids can miss narrower or unsampled interference. Procedural inward candidates rejected or uncertain by actual-mesh classification remain counted.

Nominally coincident circular surfaces use different polygon segment counts; the retained measured sub-micron overlaps and air separations are numerical appearance joins, not a fabrication-fit certificate.
PCB outline, seat, hidden package steps, clipped leads, solder, package yaw and optical recess remain appearance inferences identified in product metadata.
The audit covers passive geometry only. It does not validate optical response, sensing, firmware, device execution, electrical behaviour, labels or browser appearance.
